<a id="priority"></a>

### priority?

```ts
optional priority?: number;
```

Execution phase:
negative is permanent before movement,
0–1 is transient before movement,
1 or greater is transient after movement.

[`ModuleOptions`](ModuleOptions.md).[`priority`](ModuleOptions.md#priority)
